links.evidence: Our pharmaceutical distribution contract with Walgreen Co. ("Walgreens") expired on August 31, 2013
We sell our industrial engines to manufacturers of construction and agricultural equipment, including Hyundai Heavy Industries
The principal customers of our heavy-duty truck engines include truck manufacturers such as ... Daimler Trucks North America (Daimler)
Dell Inc. (Dell) accounted for 16% of our net revenue (15% in 2013 and 14% in 2012)
Ingram Micro accounted for 10% of our total net revenue for both fiscal 2021 and 2020, respectively
PACCAR is our largest customer, accounting for 16 percent of our consolidated net sales in 2022, 15 percent in 2021 and 15 percent in 2020
In the United Kingdom, we partner in a cost-sharing arrangement with another supplier, Bacardi Limited, to sell a portfolio of both companies’ brands
We also have a 50 percent equity interest in Häagen-Dazs Japan, Inc. (HDJ). This joint venture manufactures, distributes, and markets Häagen-Dazs ice cream products and frozen novelties
In 2013, we acquired ZTEC Instruments Inc. ("ZTEC"), a supplier of modular wireless test instruments
One of our distributors, Future Electronics, accounted for approximately 10% of our net sales in fiscal 2012
